fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics has fallen sharply from June high of 374,500 won to mid-October low of 204,500 won, while analyst price targets widened from 270,000 won (BNK Securities) to 670,000 won (Nomura Securities) during the same period.
fields.summary_ko.1: Operating profit for Q3 2026 exceeded 100 trillion won for the first time (operating margin approximately 55%), with divergence in price targets driven by differences in views on sustainability of memory supply shortage and HBM4 mass production improvement.
